Hi Alex / Tara —

I’m Rishi (Director, Applied Security at Redwood). Happy to help with the intake. A few notes on evidence expectations to make uploads smoother:
- Preferred evidence formats: PDFs for policies, exported CSV or PDFs for config listings, screenshots for console settings, and logs as zipped CSVs.
- Typical evidence items: access control matrix, firewall/network config screenshots, IAM role lists, change management records, sample alerting logs (redacted as needed), encryption key management policy. The attached evidence-checklist.pdf lists common items.
- SOC 2 Type II PDF: we can share after we have a signed DPA. If you can confirm procurement cadence, I can send the DPA DocuSign link to the procurement address.

I can run a 30-minute evidence handoff call next week to walk through the checklist and expected file naming conventions. Available slots (PT):
- Tue 2026-08-18 10:00–10:30
- Tue 2026-08-18 15:00–15:30
- Wed 2026-08-19 09:00–09:30

Let me know which works and I’ll send a calendar invite. We’ll review uploads within 3 business days of receipt and call out any gaps.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Applied Security | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
